observed_image_notes: Four RAM boards were inspected. In first-capture samples the index joints are compressed in projection; one sample places tip 8 almost on top of MCP 5.
The user confirmed the first index was straight toward the camera. A front-facing still cannot establish true physical depth or exact joint error.
Second-capture samples show a visibly extended index with greater projected spread; YOU is still not the first guess.

The live thumb is laterally extended in these samples; the selected P12 reference has a more tucked thumb. Different views/shapes are observed, but no semantic gesture error or causal mechanism is established.
interpretation: View-dependent and compressed hand estimates are a supported concern. Compression alone cannot explain both errors; the second capture is also YES. No universal correction is established.
limits: Four selected stills from two confirmed captures, not a measured landmark error rate or general accuracy.
Public probes are middle tracked frames, which can include transitions/rest. No fitted threshold or classifier.
Estimated local z is not measured physical hand depth. Softmax scores are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
